description: Your own answers to the 11 work-profile questions. Each key has answer, status (proposed, confirmed, corrected or empty), source and the numbers behind it. A question with no saved answer is the live proposal from your data (status proposed, source scan). Friction, bottleneck and magic wand are private and only returned to you. Processes are title, kind, cadence, step count and status. Never another person's answers.
name: get_my_work_profile
title: My work profile
